channel.title: Thomas Mason's Curation Feed
channel.description: This is my curation feed. This is where I re-publish content that I like. You should make one too.

item.title: Journaling tips from Struthless
item.description: One of my favorite Youtubers, Struthless, made a video where he outlines his VOMIT journalling system. The idea is to help people get a better idea of how they can sit down at a blank page and journal in an actually useful way.

item.title: Art of Manliness RSS
item.description: This blog posts a lot of great content about embracing wholesome manliness. I especially like the Odds & Ends posts.

item.title: HIDARI
item.description: A stop-motion samurai film done anime style that's in the works. It probably won't be out for a while, but it's darn cool!

item.description: I liked this song. It's an instrumental.
